player_prompt.intro:
Uza kubona {N} amanani alindileki ngokuzenzekelayo.
Kuqala lolo mzeku, nxiba [accept] ukuthoba *ithile* ithile, noma [continue] ukuziphatheka na kubona ithile elilandelayo.
Ukungabi namkela, kufuneka ukuthobe ithile elingozini.
Udibana (ithemba = 1) **kuphela** ukuthoba uthile uthile uliphezulu kwezinye zonke.

outcome.summary: Wamthanda ithile {value} kwipili {draw_num}/{N}. Eyona nje yeyomthetho yileyo {best}. {result}
